overview: A full set of tools crafted from smooth quartz blocks. Between iron and diamond, the easiest tools in the game to enchant, but fragile.

2.2.1: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
2.2.0: Quartz tools sit between iron and diamond now: iron's mining level, so obsidian and ancient debris still need diamond, mining speed 7 (was 10) and +2.5 damage (was +4).
The axe hits as hard as an iron or diamond one, and the hoe no longer out-hits other hoes.
Tools already in a world take the new numbers.
2.1.0: With Smithing Templates installed, quartz tools take trims at the smithing table, and the trim shows on the tool.
2.0.2: The mod menu icon matches the one on the download pages.
2.0.1: Quartz mines faster than netherite without mining faster than everything.
2.0.0: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword, with an advancement for each recipe.
A quartz tool in hand is what unlocks the rest.
